contexts.text: There is nothing which... is not composite, and which does not come forth from what is prior to itself. AC 9128:3. AC 9473. HH 9. DLW 303.
It is contrary to order for the posterior to inflow into the prior...
The good itself which is of life is prior (to truth).
The priority is in good, and not in truth. Explained.
That as to time the doctrine of truth was apparently prior. Signified, Explained.
By prior, or the priority, which is signified by birthright, is meant not only priority of time, but also priority of degree...
Exteriors depend on interiors, as posteriors on priors...
What the apparent priority of truth is AC 3607:3.
Thus good becomes in the prior place... AC 3607:3.
As, in the Sensuous, as in the ultimate of order, prior things are together...
The internal or prior way... The external or posterior way.
Everything in the world comes forth... from what is prior to itself; and this prior... from what is prior to itself...
The Rational is higher, or interior; or according to the wonted formula, prior; and the Natural is lower or exterior, consequently, posterior.
That this good is prior in time, not in state. Signified.
Natural good not spiritual is prior in time; and spiritual natural good is prior in state... To be prior in state is to be more eminent as to quality.
For the prior has regard to what is sequent in a continual series; and produces series of consequences to eternity.
Prior things must be in ultimates in order to come forth and appear in that sphere; and besides, all prior things tend to ultimates... and therein come forth together; like causes in their effects...
Without correspondence with the Grand Man... nothing would have connection with what is prior to itself...
When the prior is taken away, the posterior necessarily falls; in like manner if the prior is separated from the posterior.
It is a general law... that the prior can subsist with its own prior; but not without it with the posterior. Explained.
The Natural perceives... from what is prior to itself; and (this) prior perceives from what is prior still to itself...
Former years () = the states of the Ancient Church.

Thus posterior things come forth by formations from prior ones. Hence it is that... the posterior depends on the prior, insomuch that it cannot subsist without the prior; for the posterior is kept in its connection and form by the prior. (Thus) also in the posterior are all the prior things in their order.
He continued there his former life, as do all.
Intermediates are... between things in a prior degree and those in a posterior one; for the sake of conjunction.
The prior and posterior states of regeneration. Explained.
The right of priority and superiority (of truth) over the good of charity; yet the (latter) is actually prior...
The Spiritual and the Natural are distinct as are the prior and the posterior...
As the prior is in the posterior successively...
Discrete degrees are discriminated as are the prior and the posterior...
These three degrees are distinguished from each other as are... the prior, the posterior, and the postreme; but they make a one by correspondences. DLW 184:2.
(The communication between the two worlds is not as) between purer and grosser; but as between prior and posterior...
Causes are prior, and effects posterior; and prior things cannot be seen from posterior ones; but posterior ones from prior.
The difference (between cause and effect) is as between the prior and the posterior, or as between that which forms and that which is formed.

It appears as if prior things must be less perfect than posterior ones, or simples than composites; yet prior things, out of which posterior ones are formed... are the more perfect. The reason is that the prior or simpler are more naked, and less covered over with substances and matters devoid of life; and are as it were more Divine...
For all that is prior, the more prior it is... being more perfect... is the more exempt from injury.
For every ultimate consists of prior things, and these of their primes.
The Spiritual World is distinct from the natural as is the prior from the posterior...
There is nothing but what is from what is prior to itself; and this from what is still prior to it; and so at last from the first, which is in Itself. ISB 11:4. AE 349:5.
They know no other than that they are in the former world...

The difference between the substantial and the material is like that between the prior and the posterior; and the prior, being in itself purer, cannot appear to the posterior, which in itself is grosser; nor can the posterior... appear to the prior... consequently an Angel cannot appear to a man, nor a man to an Angel.

He said. What is the Spiritual unless it is a purer Natural? I replied, The difference is not such; but is such as is between the prior and the posterior, between which there is no finite proportion; for the prior is in the posterior as the cause in its effect; and the posterior is from the prior as the effect from its cause. Hence it is that the one does not appear to the other.
All posteriors are (thus) receptacles of priors, and these of priors yet, and so in order of the primitives of which the (spiritual) Sun consists...
Interiors, or priors, so called, because they are nearer to their first.
Posteriors acknowledge their priors as parents from which they come forth and subsist.
As ultimates are directed by the Lord from priors, so on the other hand are priors from ultimates. SE 5615:end.
To view the world by a prior way... is to view it from the light of Heaven.

What the prior and posterior are. Explained... (Thus) charity is actually prior, and faith posterior... as that which produces is essentially prior to that which is produced; and as esse is prior to existere...

The distinction (between the degrees of life) is like that between priors and posteriors; for a posterior degree comes forth from the prior one; (and) that which, is of a prior degree is less general... DLove 11:2.
